subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw ship the new agents.defaults/list iterationBudget config, onBeforeToolCallingRound hook, supportsIterationBudget flag, and unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior as the public release contract after the blocking budget-result bug is fixed?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-visible config and harness/API contract; code review can identify defects, but final names, defaults, and fail-closed semantics are product/compatibility choices.

options.title: Accept contract after the bug fix
options.body: Land the opt-in budget contract once the silent budget-block path reliably returns budget_exhausted and normal gates pass.

options.title: Rename or narrow before release
options.body: Change config names, defaults, or hook semantics before merge so shipped users and plugin harnesses do not inherit a contract maintainers do not want.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep design discussion in the canonical maxTurns/maxToolCalls issue if maintainers are not ready to bless a hard iteration-budget contract.

recommendation.title: Accept contract after the bug fix
recommendation.body: Land the opt-in budget contract once the silent budget-block path reliably returns budget_exhausted and normal gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned and authored the latest follow-up commits that tightened the budget behavior, making them the best current routing owner for the maintainer choice.
